svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration for AI Product UX. A long pale strip lies on a dotted floor like a timeline. Four small cards stand on it: one from a person, two marked AI, and in the middle a lime card marked AI with an undo arrow. A pale customer at the far end reaches toward the undone AI card, and a solid blue support person wearing a headset at the near end leans in with a fingertip on the same history.
